title: two variadic constructors with the same tail type are duplicates
purpose: Variadic constructor calls are positional, so names cannot distinguish them.

failure.justification: A declaration-level rule checked after parsing; an implementation may also detect it at registration/runtime. The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for typed and variadic overloads
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.3: constructors with the same parameter types and variadic tail are the same signature.
